title: Why Iran seeks permanent end to war, not temporary ceasefire?
body: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Republic of Iran has emphasized that the key objective in the ongoing war is to eliminate the threat and secure a decisive and permanent end to the war, stressing that a temporary ceasefire without guarantees against renewed aggression would not provide lasting stability.

title: Iran’s Armenian Olympics held in Tehran
body: The 57th Armenian Olympics of Iran kicked off on September 9, 2026 at the Ararat Stadium in Tehran, with the presence of Minister of Culture Reza Salehi Amiri, and Armenian representatives in Parliament, among other attendees. A classic car exhibition was also held.

title: Late‑summer crowds visit Ganjnameh in western Iran
body: The images show Ganjnameh in the city of Hamedan, western Iran, on September 11, 2026, as it welcomes travelers from across the country visiting the historical site and other attractions during the final days of summer.

title: Iran reaches Men's Volleyball Asian Championship final after beating Australia
body: Tehran, IRNA – Iran reached the final of the AVC Men's Volleyball Asian Championship after defeating Australia 3-1 in the semifinal in Fukuoka, Japan, on Saturday.

title: Almond Festival in northwest Iran
body: The city of Khosrowshah, in Iran’s East Azarbaijan Province, hosted its second edition of Almon Festival on Wednesday evening (September 9). People and local officials from across the province, including the provincial capital, Tabriz, were in attendance.

title: Civil aviation must not be used as tool of political pressure: Iranian official
body: Tehran, IRNA — The head of Iran’s Civil Aviation Organization has condemned the United States for imposing broad and unilateral sanctions on the country’s civil aviation sector, warning that the continuation of such measures could harm regional and international aviation.

title: Malaysian envoy welcomes Iran Air’s return to East Asia

title: Pezeshkian calls for stronger economic, financial ties among BRICS members
